choices.en: bajie slept outside of the cave.

answer_evidence.quote: "The bodhisattva Lingji lives on Mount Sumeru. I will ask him for help—quickly!"
When he arrived on Mount Sumeru, Lingji came out of his pagoda.
"He's a weasel spirit. Buddha asked me to keep an eye on him. I told the spirit he could live on that mountain if he behaved."
The two of them went back out and found Bajie sleeping.
